title: Interactive Floating Circles Animation with JavaScript Canvas
description:
🎨 Interactive Floating Circles Animation with JavaScript Canvas

🔵✨ This animation creates a mesmerizing effect with colorful floating circles that bounce around the screen and react when the mouse moves nearby. It's a lightweight, interactive background effect that enhances visual appeal!

🚀 JavaScript Methods Used

🖌️ Canvas API → Draws and animates the circles.
🖱️ Mouse Events (mousemove) → Expands circles when hovered over.
📏 Window Resize Listener → Adjusts canvas dynamically.
🎲 Math.random() → Generates random positions, colors, and speeds.
⚡ requestAnimationFrame() → Ensures smooth 60 FPS animation.

🎯 Who is this for?

👩‍💻 Frontend developers exploring Canvas API.
🖍️ UI/UX designers looking for interactive effects.
💡 Developers adding dynamic backgrounds to websites.

🎯 When to Use This?

🌐 Background animations for websites.
🕹️ Interactive elements in web applications.
🛠️ Fun JavaScript practice for animations!

This effect is fully customizable—change colors, speed, or even add gravity for a unique look! 🚀
shortDescription: Learn how to create an interactive floating circles animation using HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript. This effect features colorful bouncing circles that respond to mouse movement, expanding when hovered over. Ideal for background animations or visual experiments!
